newsitem.title: ALBANIA: Key bridge to Sarande bombed in S. Albania.
newsitem.headline: Key bridge to Sarande bombed in S. Albania.

text.p: A key bridge to rebel-held Sarande in southern Albania has been bombed, limiting access to the coastal town, a Reuters photographer at the scene said on Thursday.
He said the heavily-armed rebels were building up defences around the town, blocking access roads every 100 metres (yards) with trucks to prepare against any possible assault by the army.
The Muzine road is one of two land links into Sarande, which was seized by rebels during widespread rioting over the weekend.
Thousands of local residents are now heavily armed after joining the Sarande uprising and having stolen arms from state arsenals. They are defiantly challenging President Sali Berisha.

A deep crater, five metres (yards) across, was blasted in the road on the Muzine bridge and only private cars could skirt around it. It was unclear which side, rebels or army, had blown up the bridge during heavy fighting in the region on Wednesday.
